{"path": "plot_results.py", "content": "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

# Data for Mind2Web dataset results
splits = ['Cross-Task', 'Cross-Website', 'Cross-Domain']

# Success rates for each method
mindact = [36.2, 30.1, 26.4]
awm_offline = [45.1, 33.7, 32.6]
awm_online = [43.6, 33.9, 35.5]

# Set up the figure
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 6))

# Bar width
bar_width = 0.25

# X positions for the groups
x = np.arange(len(splits))

# Create bars for each method
bars1 = ax.bar(x - bar_width, mindact, bar_width, label='MindAct (Baseline)', 
               color='#1f77b4', edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.2)
bars2 = ax.bar(x, awm_offline, bar_width, label='AWM-offline', 
               color='#ff7f0e', edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.2)
bars3 = ax.bar(x + bar_width, awm_online, bar_width, label='AWM-online', 
               color='#2ca02c', edgecolor='black', linewidth=1.2)

# Customize the plot
ax.set_xlabel('Split Type', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_ylabel('Success Rate (%)', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_title('Mind2Web Dataset: Method Comparison Across Splits', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold', pad=15)
ax.set_xticks(x)
ax.set_xticklabels(splits, fontsize=11)
ax.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=10)
ax.set_ylim(0, 55)
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3, linestyle='--')

# Add value labels on top of each bar
def add_labels(bars):
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        ax.annotate(f'{height:.1f}',
                    xy=(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width() / 2, height),
                    xytext=(0, 3),
                    textcoords="offset points",
                    ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9, fontweight='bold')

add_labels(bars1)
add_labels(bars2)
add_labels(bars3)

# Add annotation for key insight 1: AWM methods outperform MindAct
ax.annotate('Both AWM methods\noutperform MindAct',
            xy=(0.5, 48),
            xytext=(0.5, 52),
            ha='center', va='bottom',
            fontsize=10, fontweight='bold',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='wheat', alpha=0.8),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.2'))

# Add annotation for key insight 2: AWM-online surpasses AWM-offline in cross-domain
ax.annotate('AWM-online > AWM-offline\nin Cross-Domain',
            xy=(2, 35.5),
            xytext=(2.3, 38),
            ha='left', va='bottom',
            fontsize=10, fontweight='bold',
            color='darkgreen',
            bbox=dict(boxstyle='round', facecolor='lightgreen', alpha=0.8),
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.2', color='darkgreen'))

# Add trend annotation for AWM-online improvement
ax.annotate('AWM-online\nimproves in\nCross-Domain',
            xy=(2, 35.5),
            xytext=(1.2, 30),
            ha='right', va='top',
            fontsize=9,
            color='darkgreen',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', connectionstyle='arc3,rad=0.3', color='darkgreen'))

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('mind2web_comparison.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
print("Plot saved as 'mind2web_comparison.png'")

# Also save the annotated version
plt.savefig('mind2web_comparison_annotated.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
print("Annotated plot saved as 'mind2web_comparison_annotated.png'")

plt.show()"}
